findings.description: Optical window frame wall is 0.35 mm; SLA minimum wall is 0.5 mm supported / 1.0 mm unsupported (Tough 2000). Frame will not print or will break.
Boss at x=18, y=8 (d=3 mm, 6 mm tall) lies inside the 40 x 25 mm cell footprint (x +/-20, y +/-12.5): it collides with and presses on the LiPo cell, violating REQ-MECH-002.
Tether cores are soldered straight to PCB pads with no boot, clamp or knot; a 20 N pull (REQ-MECH-004) loads the solder joints directly.
Worst case is 0.20 +/- 0.25 = -0.05 to 0.45 mm (gasket tolerance omitted); report calls a 0.00 mm minimum a PASS against the 0.05 mm limit of REQ-MECH-003.
LDO dissipation is (5.0 - 1.8) x 0.150 = 0.48 W, not 0.048 W (150 mA written as 0.015 A); Tj = 40 + 0.48 x 210 = 141 C > 105 C limit of REQ-ELEC-003.
Exposed charging contacts route straight to U1 with no TVS or ESD clamp; REQ-ELEC-002 requires surviving +/-8 kV IEC 61000-4-2 contact discharge.
Verify: test but tests[] is empty and the test plan has no ESD test; the requirement is untested.
Claims AFib detection and medical-grade accuracy with no evidence entry; this is a regulated medical device claim with no clinical data.
